packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once all required checks pass
Language runtimes and system tools come from the Ubuntu APT repositories of ubuntu-latest and follow the Ubuntu LTS, so their maintenance and security updates arrive through APT, not through Renovate
Workflow actions are referenced by tag and pinned by actions.lock; a commit SHA in a workflow fails at startup where the lockfile is required, so Renovate must not pin digests
